description: Is this company or domain legit? Business and domain verification (KYB) for vendor screening, supplier checks and scam or fraud review: domain age and registrar from RDAP, DNS (A/MX/NS), email security (SPF/DMARC) and HTTPS. Returns a verdict and a 0-100 trust score with evidence URLs, and flags newly registered or thin-infrastructure domains, a common scam signal. Use it before your agent pays an invoice, onboards a vendor or trusts a site. Signed attestation. Bulk: /verify/business/batch. Free tier is unsigned and rate-limited. For a cryptographically signed attestation with no daily limit ($0.05 USDC), add an x402 payment header to THIS SAME tool call (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for v2, X-PAYMENT for v1) or POST /verify/business over HTTP. Same price on either transport.
